# KafkaUnderMinISR

<!-- GENERATED by monitoring/dashgen from internal/rules (make alerts). Do not edit. -->

| Severity | Component | Dashboard | for (production / demo) |
|---|---|---|---|
| critical | kafka | [kafka-broker](http://grafana.localhost:8080/d/kafka-broker/) | 1m / 15s |

**Summary:** Partitions of cluster <kafka_cluster> are below min.insync.replicas

Producers with acks=all receive NOT_ENOUGH_REPLICAS for these partitions — writes fail. Find the broker(s) that are down or too slow to stay in sync.

## Impact

Producers with acks=all get NOT_ENOUGH_REPLICAS (or time out) for the affected partitions — writes fail; reads still work.

## Diagnosis

1. Kafka · Broker Deep Dive → Replication & ISR: which broker shrinks ISRs, which follower lags (replica fetcher max lag)?
2. Check the follower brokers for GC pauses (Kafka · JVM), disk saturation and CPU throttling (Kafka · Pods & Nodes).

## Mitigation

- Restore the lagging/down broker; followers re-join the ISR automatically once caught up.
- Temporarily lowering min.insync.replicas restores writes at the cost of durability — only with explicit approval.

## Expression

```promql
sum by (kafka_cluster) (kafka_server_replicamanager_underminisrpartitioncount) > 0
```
